baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive construction and the sole rooted noun at word 4 present the addressee as a nadhir.
baseline_models.mechanism: A danger notice is delivered so that caution can awaken; the restriction confines the addressee-facing function to giving that alert.

activation_trace.role: Threat-notice that awakens caution supplies both the literal warning and its alerting function in the clause.

changed_reading.before: A flat occupational label: you are a warner.
changed_reading.after: A bounded communicative office: your act is to place a danger signal before hearers so that caution can begin.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root at word 4 also carries a form-distant self-obligation branch, while the restrictive syntax presents a person confined to one charge.
baseline_models.mechanism: At root level, self-binding obligation faintly recasts the title as an undertaken duty to keep warning, not merely a description of message content.

activation_trace.role: Self-imposed obligation supplies an exploratory duty-frame for the restrictive identification.

changed_reading.before: The noun only names what the addressee is.
changed_reading.after: The root resonance also lets the line portray him as held to a singular warning-duty, though this is not the noun's direct lexical sense here.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning becomes a counter-perceptual intervention: it interrupts an attractive but unstable surface before mis-seeing bad action as good can settle into conduct.

activation_trace.role: The caution-awakening alert anchors the focus as an intervention in risk perception.
Deception by what gleams without holding supplies the misleading surface that the alert must puncture.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the active cosmetic operation by which bad action gains appeal.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the uptake point where the beautified act is accepted as good.

structural_cues: 35:5 repeats the prohibition against deception, and 35:8 stages beautification, perception as good, and the addressee's grief before the focus restriction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive shine, beautification, and seeing evil as good; I infer that warning counter-calibrates perception rather than merely adding threat information. A live alternative is that it only announces the outcome while guidance remains a separate act.

changed_reading.before: The warner reports an external danger.
changed_reading.after: The warner also disrupts the visual and evaluative process by which danger has been made to look desirable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning addresses an agent whose burden and purification remain personal: the messenger can awaken caution but cannot carry, cleanse, or answer in the recipient's place.

activation_trace.role: The alert that awakens caution supplies the messenger's bounded contribution to another person's response.
A heavy burden supplies the responsibility that cannot be transferred from one moral agent to another.
Bearing an entrusted burden supplies the blocked substitution: even a called helper does not assume it.
The explicit act of warning links the focus office to recipients characterized by awakened caution.
Fear joined with awe supplies the receptive orientation in which the warning takes effect.
Purification and rectification supply the response that the recipient must perform rather than receive by proxy.
The very self of the person supplies the beneficiary and owner of purification.

structural_cues: 35:18 moves from repeated burden non-transfer, through 'you warn only', to repeated self-purification for oneself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-transferable burden, selective warning, and self-benefiting purification; I infer that the restriction in 35:23 bounds the messenger's agency at the edge of the recipient's own response. A live alternative is that 35:18 concerns final liability without directly defining messenger agency.

changed_reading.before: The restriction merely limits the speaker's job description.
changed_reading.after: It marks an ethical boundary: warning can address and awaken, but response, burden, and purification remain the hearer's own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is a perceptible signal, not a power that manufactures perception, life, or compliance; paired capacities and their absences determine uptake.

activation_trace.role: The danger signal supplies communicative input while leaving the hearer's receptive capacity outside the office.
Loss of sight supplies one pole of the immediate capacity contrast.
Actual seeing supplies the contrasted capacity by which a disclosed distinction can be taken in.
Possession of life supplies the responsive side of the living/dead contrast.
Loss of force and life supplies the extreme image of unavailable uptake.
Causing another to hear supplies the precise causal power denied to the addressee.
Understanding and complying extend hearing beyond acoustics and make the denied uptake socially consequential.
Burial of the dead supplies the terminal spatial image for hearers beyond the warner's causal reach.

structural_cues: The paired contrasts of 35:19-22 culminate in inability to make grave-dwellers hear, immediately before the restrictive focus clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired capacities and the explicit inability to make those in graves hear; I infer that warning transmits a signal but cannot create receptive life or compliance. A live alternative is that the grave image is strictly eschatological rather than an analogy for present moral unresponsiveness.

changed_reading.before: A successful warning should make its audience change.
changed_reading.after: The office is fulfilled by making the alert available; actual hearing and compliance depend on a receptivity the warner cannot compel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah expands the restricted identity into a truth-backed, recurrent messenger office that carries both good news and warning to communities across passing generations.

activation_trace.role: The warning alert remains the focus-side office whose scope is revised by the adjacent expansion.
Messenger and message supply the commissioned relay framework rather than autonomous control.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the warrant carried by the paired announcements.
Joy-opening news supplies the positive pole that prevents 'only a warner' from excluding all favorable content.
Repeated warning links the individual commission to the recurrent office present among communities.
A community as a gathered human kind supplies the social unit repeatedly reached by warning.
Passing time and departed generations supply the historical recurrence of the office.

structural_cues: 35:24 immediately repeats the focus noun, pairs it with good news, and uses another negation-exception construction for every community.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent pairing of good news and warning, a truth-backed sending, and warning in every community; I infer that the focus restriction primarily limits human status and causal agency rather than limiting all message content to threat. A live alternative is that 35:23 locally foregrounds the warning side even though 35:24 states the fuller mission.

changed_reading.before: Only a warner means the addressee carries no positive announcement and occupies a reduced role.
changed_reading.after: Only a warner limits him to commissioned communication rather than outcome-control; that office is truth-backed, includes a paired positive announcement, and recurs across communities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The alert's fear-awakening function is refined into informed caution: attention to differentiated kinds discloses a pattern, and knowledge rather than raw alarm matures into awe.

activation_trace.role: The warning that awakens caution supplies the affective movement later disciplined by observation and knowledge.
Distinct kinds supply observable differentiation rather than an undivided field of signs.
Kinds differentiated among living beings extend the perceptual field from landscape to social and animal life.
Fear with awe supplies the mature caution toward which warning points.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the cognitive condition that turns alarm into discerning awe.

structural_cues: 35:27-28 accumulate visible differences and end by restricting awe to those who know, echoing the focus verse's restrictive form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiated kinds followed by knowledge-conditioned awe; I infer that warning trains discriminating attention so its fear is epistemic rather than panic. A live alternative is that the knowledge-awe relation concerns creation directly and does not describe how warning works.

changed_reading.after: Warning can educate attention until patterned difference becomes knowledge and danger-awareness matures into reverent caution.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning opens a finite interval for recollection and repaired action; after adequate lifetime and evidentiary notice, taking-to-account answers acquired conduct at its appointed limit.

activation_trace.role: The caution-awakening notice anchors the focus as an intervention delivered before the response interval closes.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing supplies the consequence that follows the messenger-and-evidence sequence.
Rectitude opposed to corruption supplies the changed action requested only after the opportunity has passed.
Extended life in time supplies the duration in which warning could become response.
Bringing something back to mind supplies the cognitive action made possible during that duration.
The warner's arrival supplies concrete notice within the remembered lifetime, not an abstract future threat.
Acquiring what one pursues supplies personal ownership of the conduct answered at judgment.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the closing boundary of the response window.

structural_cues: 35:25-26 place taking after messengers and evidence; 35:37 joins sufficient lifetime, remembrance, the warner's arrival, and a too-late request to act differently; 35:45 ends with deferment to a named term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies notice before taking, adequate lifespan, recollection, a late request for repaired action, and deferment to a term; I infer that warning opens a finite decision interval and later closes an excuse. A live alternative is that warning functions only as retrospective evidence, not as the cause of an opportunity.

changed_reading.before: The warning predicts a later consequence.
changed_reading.after: The warning is timed prior notice that makes present recollection and changed action possible before an appointed closure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warner's arrival becomes a diagnostic event: it tests advance claims, exposes withdrawal, and places that response inside a recurring pattern whose plotted harm circles back and whose outcome remains inspectable.

activation_trace.role: The alert anchors the event whose reception, rather than mere delivery, reveals the audience's orientation.
The twice-mentioned warner supplies the before-and-after hinge between promised guidance and actual reaction.
Drawing away from a thing supplies the revealed direction of the audience's response.
Harm descending upon and enclosing its source supplies the reversal by which resistance returns on its makers.
A running, followed way supplies the recurrent historical pattern into which this reaction falls.
Moving through the land supplies the active audit by which the pattern can be inspected.
The end and outcome of a process supply the historical result exposed to inspection.

structural_cues: 35:42 contrasts a pre-arrival oath with post-arrival aversion; 35:43-44 then move through self-returning plot, an invariant historical way, travel, and observed outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a claimed readiness, the warner's arrival, increased aversion, enclosing harm, and an inspectable historical pattern; I infer that warning applies diagnostic pressure that reveals orientation. A live alternative is that warning only precedes, rather than exposes or intensifies, independently motivated arrogance.

changed_reading.before: Warning is successful only when it persuades.
changed_reading.after: Warning also tests prior claims and makes refusal historically legible; aversion can reveal the hearer even when persuasion fails.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the root's vow branch beneath a surface that directly denotes a warner. It remains anchored through the focus root and becomes live when 35:42 surrounds two occurrences of the same noun with strenuous oath language and then broken behavioral expectation. Render it only as root-level resonance: it does not replace the lexical sense of nadhir with 'vow'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The n-dh-r root at focus word 4 and its self-obligation branch, sharpened by the restrictive presentation of a singular duty.

activation_trace.role: Self-binding obligation supplies the faint duty resonance within the focus title.
A formally allotted oath supplies the audience's explicit self-binding claim before the warner arrives.
Exerting full capacity under strain supplies the stated intensity of that oath.
The oath sense supplies an unambiguous context activator for the root-distant self-obligation branch.
The repeated root beside the oath language creates a mirror between the warner's steady charge and the audience's failed self-binding promise.
Withdrawal from the arrived warner supplies the behavioral collapse of the prior oath.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives only an occupational warning title.
changed_reading.after: At root-resonance level, it also stages asymmetrical obligation: the warning-duty holds steady while the audience's sworn readiness fails on contact.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the root branch concerns a wound carrying mandatory compensation, far from the direct sense of the focus noun. It remains anchored in n-dh-r and is activated by the sequence of truth-backed warning, taking for wrongdoing, sufficient time to remember, earned conduct, and an appointed term. Render it as a juridical-material analogy in which prior notice makes liability assessable, never as a claim that the noun literally means wound or compensation here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The n-dh-r root at focus word 4 through its assessed-wound branch, with the focus restriction isolating the act that precedes accounting.

activation_trace.role: A wound carrying an obligatory assessed claim supplies the exploratory analogy of warning as liability-marking notice.
A fixed obligation or entitlement supplies the juridical edge of the truth-backed commission.
Taking for wrongdoing supplies enforcement after the warning-and-evidence sequence.
The warning's arrival during sufficient lifetime supplies prior notice within the liability analogy.
Accountability-taking for wrongdoing supplies the later claim made legible by prior notice.
Personal acquisition supplies the acts to which the assessed consequence attaches.
A fixed term supplies the due boundary at which deferred accounting arrives.

changed_reading.before: Warning is information about possible harm.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch analogy, warning also marks a claim before enforcement, making later accountability for acquired acts assessable rather than unannounced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a speech office onto the material movement of wind, cloud, and revived land. It remains anchored in the focus warning branch and in 35:9's chain of sending, stirring, driving, and enlivening; 35:22 prevents treating the analogy as guaranteed conversion. Render it as a transport-and-activation model for how an alert enters a receptive field, not as the lexical meaning of nadhir or a claim that the messenger gives life.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun as a delivered caution-awakening signal whose effect depends on the field it enters.

activation_trace.role: The delivered danger signal supplies the focus-side element compared with a moving atmospheric activation.
Dispatch and outward movement supply the first transport step of the material analogy.
Moving wind supplies the carrier that crosses space before any visible result.
Stirring a thing from its place supplies latent activation rather than completed transformation.
A cloud drawn along supplies the gathered medium made mobile by the dispatched wind.
Driving onward supplies directional transfer toward the field that may receive the effect.
Land coming alive through rain and growth supplies the endpoint that motivates, but does not guarantee, the warning analogy.

changed_reading.before: The warning is a static utterance aimed at an individual hearer.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it is a dispatched signal that travels, stirs dormant potential, and drives toward response while remaining distinct from the power that gives life.

strongest_changes: The adjacent pairing of good news and warning moves the focus restriction away from threat-only content and toward bounded messenger agency within a universal office.
The burden, purification, sight, hearing, life, and grave sequences make warning non-transferable and reception-dependent rather than coercively effective.
The lifespan, remembrance, oath, aversion, historical pattern, earned conduct, and term sequences turn warning into finite prior notice and a diagnostic event.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root's ordinary alert branch connected several causal domains, while its self-obligation and assessed-wound branches became live only under the later oath and accountability sequences; the dispatched-weather sequence preserved a separate material analogy.
remaining_uncertainties: The restriction may locally foreground warning more narrowly even though the next ayah broadens the commission to good news and warning.
The hearing and grave contrast may be strictly eschatological rather than a model of present moral receptivity.
The oath, assessed-liability, and weather readings are contained root or domain resonances, not direct lexical substitutions.
